build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places two balls on platforms with a blocker and peak obstacle
create_task_with_define_task_template: create a parameterized task using define_task_template decorator with platform positions and peak direction variations
add_static_bar: add a static bar object to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene positioned on top of a platform
update_task_relationships: update the task objective to require two balls to be touching using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
